problem_statement: When the DNS-SD discovery proxy forwards a record query whose resource record carries an embedded DNS name using the mDNS '.local.' domain (e.g. a CNAME pointing to 'protectors.local'), the response sent back to the DNS client contains the RDATA verbatim, with the name left in the '.local.' form. The client expects the embedded name to be translated into the Thread network domain 'default.service.arpa.' (e.g. 'protectors.default.service.arpa.'). Queries for records whose RDATA embeds one or more DNS names (CNAME, NS, SOA, PTR, MX, SRV, etc.) must have that embedded name rewritten to the translated domain in the response before it is delivered to the client.
